database.description: Exact MongoDB database that holds the collection.

collection.description: Exact collection, view or time-series collection name.

filter.description: Query filter as a MongoDB Extended JSON object, canonical or relaxed, such as {"_id": {"$oid": "..."}}. Omit to match every document.

projection.description: Projection as a MongoDB Extended JSON object.

sort.description: Sort as a MongoDB Extended JSON object, such as {"_id": 1}. Key order is significant.

skip.description: Documents to skip before returning results; combine with sort for a stable order.

row_limit.description: Maximum documents to return. Defaults to this connection's limits.max_rows from list_connections and must not exceed it.
